title: itemref
summary: MSUI now carries current Benilla hyperlink identity through color-run parsing and pixel wrapping, emits player links for ordinary chat senders, draws clickable/underlined link regions, and routes player links to whisper, the shared law-driven FRIEND menu, or Shift insertion. Item links open a persistent dynamically sized ItemRefTooltip at a dedicated-law bottom-center seat with template-backed content and the reference corner close button; Shift inserts their reconstructed hyperlink markup. Ctrl-click dressing-room preview remains absent because MSUI has no dressing-room subsystem.

openItems.text: No |H...|h chat hyperlink parsing or clickable link regions in the chat frame
openItems.resolution: Chat storage preserves pipe escapes; UiTextMarkupLaw parses and wraps hyperlinks without losing shared link identity, and the renderer creates exact-width clickable regions for every linked run.

openItems.text: No ItemRefTooltip (persistent item tooltip parked bottom-center with close button)
openItems.resolution: Item links now open a persistent template-backed tooltip at ItemRefTooltipUiLaw's bottom-center anchor, with dynamic law-owned size, tooltip backdrop, and the 32px minimize-style close control; Escape also closes it.

openItems.text: No player-link routing (left-click whisper, right-click FRIEND dropdown, shift-click editbox insert)
openItems.resolution: Ordinary player chat senders are emitted as player hyperlinks. Left-click opens a prefilled whisper, right-click opens the FRIEND variant of the shared UnitPopup at the cursor even when the player is no longer streamed, and Shift inserts the name into an open chat edit box.

openItems.text: Shift-click insertion is implemented for player/item links, but Ctrl-click item dressing-room preview remains absent because MSUI has no dressing-room subsystem
